# Aranza Isea — Senior Product Designer · AI Products

> Senior Product Designer with 10+ years in product design, UX/UI design and user research, specialized in AI products: generative AI copilots, AI agents and human-in-the-loop workflows for enterprise B2B SaaS (insurance, fintech, B2B e-commerce). Based in Buenos Aires, Argentina; works remotely (GMT-3). Spanish native, English C1. Available to start immediately.

## Experience
- Career break (sabbatical), 2025 – present: portfolio case studies, two independent AI concepts, IBM Generative AI certifications.
- Product Designer, AI Products — Perficient, 2024 – 2025: owned ClaimPro end to end (generative AI claims copilot, ~500 insurance adjusters, −68% claim resolution time client-reported over 3 months, 90%+ adoption); designed Vantage (multi-agent AI for AML compliance at a neobank).
- Senior UX/UI Designer — Perficient, 2022 – 2024: Off Dep Business (AI-assisted B2B purchasing; +65% Business accounts, +56% B2B sales, +47% retention), Club Rumbo (loyalty app MVP, iOS and Android, one month).
- Senior Visual Designer — Perficient, 2019 – 2022: built and scaled Perficient's Advanced Design System.
- Product Designer — Distrito Moda, 2017 – 2019. UX Designer — Tsserapp, 2015 – 2017.
